· The route goes through the x39tunel (WireGuard): %1$s.
· The x39tunel is off: the route is direct and the server sees your IP.

"CALLS AND VIDEO CALLS
· The two phones agree on the key between themselves, in a post-quantum way
 (ML-KEM-1024), and every offer is signed (ML-DSA-87) so nobody can
 get in the middle.
· That key gives the 32 bytes that encrypt the audio and the video, and the
 six words you check out loud.
· The server relays the packets and cannot decrypt them: the key never
 goes through it.

YOUR IDENTITY
· It is an ML-DSA-87 key. The secret part is created on this phone and stays
 here, sealed by the Keystore. Your fingerprint is derived from it.

MESSAGES AND FILES
· Every message, voice note or file chunk is sealed with its own post-quantum
 encapsulation (ML-KEM-1024) and signed (ML-DSA-87). Photos and videos are
 stripped of metadata before sealing, and stored encrypted via the Keystore.

THE ROUTE
%1$s

WHAT ENCRYPTION DOES NOT HIDE
· The server knows who talks to whom, at what time and for how long. That is
 network metadata and no key hides it. The tunnel does not hide it
 either: it only changes the path it takes."
